# Feminist Value Creation: The Pursuit of Gender Equality

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Michael J. Bloomfield  
**Year:** 2025  
**Journal:** Academy of Management Review  
**DOI:** [10.5465/amr.2023.0070](https://doi.org/10.5465/amr.2023.0070)

**Keywords:** feminist theory, value creation, gender equality, diversity, DEI, organizational theory

## Abstract

While the importance of promoting greater equality is widely recognized in management theory and practice, it has yet to be built into the core business process of value creation. This paper introduces feminist value creation as a framework for integrating gender equality into organizational value creation processes.
